read.thesis: FedEx Q4 adjusted operating margin 8.4% vs 9.1%, but Federal Express yields up 10% (US priority) and ADV only +3%; CY26 guide implies ~11% revenue growth with capex cut to 4.0% of revenue.

capex.quote: Capital spending as a percentage of revenue declined to 4.0%, the lowest annual level in FedEx Corporation history.

triggers.label: Capex 4.0% of revenue, lowest ever
triggers.quote: Capital spending as a percentage of revenue declined to 4.0%, the lowest annual level in FedEx Corporation history.

triggers.label: CY26 adj EPS $16.90-$18.10 vs CY25 $15.00
triggers.quote: Diluted earnings per share from continuing operations with adjustments (non-GAAP) $16.90 to $18.10
